title: Selectively electrolyzing CO2 to ethylene by a Cu–Cu2O/rGO catalyst derived from copper hydroxide nanostrands/graphene oxide nanosheets
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,36602-36609
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07259F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Chenxiang Peng, Bing Yao, Lei Wang, Xinyi Wan
A Cu–Cu2O/rGO catalyst was prepared via an in situ electrochemical reduction process. It demonstrated high selectivity and stable Faraday efficiency for electrolyzing CO2 to C2H4 owing to the synergistic effect of Cu–Cu+ pairs and rGO.
